name: GerSync Exchange for 1C
author: vigilansnoctis

sections.description:
The plugin implements the standard “exchange with website” protocol built into 1C configurations
(Trade Management, Small Business Management, Integrated Automation, etc.). Nothing needs to be modified on the 1C side.
A Russian version of this document is in readme-ru.txt.

Catalog (1C → website)

  • Category tree from 1C groups, products, descriptions, SKUs, weight, images.
  • 1C properties become global WooCommerce attributes (usable in filters).
  • 1C characteristics (“Id#Id”) become variable products with variations.
  • Prices: a chosen price type plus an optional “sale” price type (by name or Id).
  • Stock: summed across all warehouses; CommerceML 2.05 and 2.08+ (offers / prices / rests).
  • Products marked for deletion in 1C are moved to drafts or trash and restored with their previous
    status when the mark is removed. Products you removed manually are never touched.
  • Large catalogs are imported in steps, so hosting timeouts are not a problem.

Orders (website → 1C)

  • Orders are sent to 1C after creation and after every status change, including shipping and fees.
  • Optional: order statuses from 1C (cancelled, shipped, paid) are applied back to the website.
  • Compatible with HPOS (WooCommerce high-performance order storage).

Speed

  • Products whose data in 1C has not changed since the previous exchange are skipped; prices and stock are saved
    only when they actually change. A repeated exchange of an unchanged catalog takes seconds.
  • Images are uploaded once: identical files are recognised, including images uploaded by the previous
    1C exchange plugin (no duplicates after switching).
  • Optional “WooCommerce sizes only” mode generates fewer thumbnail files and uploads images 2–3× faster.
  • “Forced full exchange” (Maintenance tab) reprocesses every product once on the next exchange.
  • “Image cleanup” removes images uploaded by the exchange that are no longer used by any product.

Other

  • Picks up GUIDs left by the previous 1C exchange plugin (_id_1c meta), so switching does not create duplicates.
  • Polylang / WPML: when translations share a GUID, the product or category in the default language is updated;
    the exchange URL also works with a language prefix (/en/wc1c-exchange/).
  • Per-field update control for existing products: name, description, categories, images, SKU, weight, prices and stock
    can each be protected from being overwritten by 1C.
  • A “Do not update from 1C” checkbox on a product’s Inventory tab protects a hand-edited product
    (prices and stock still update).
  • Attributes: “sync with 1C”, “only add values from 1C, never remove” or “don’t touch”.
    Attributes added manually (not coming from 1C properties) are never removed in any mode.

Full export and changes-only export

  • The export type is detected automatically from the 1C file (“contains only changes” flag).
  • Changes-only export: only the received products are updated, nothing else is touched.
  • Full export: products from 1C that are missing in it can be left as is, unpublished (draft),
    set to “Out of stock” or moved to trash. Products created manually on the website are never affected.
  • Runs in the background (WooCommerce Action Scheduler) after 1C signals the end of the exchange,
    or 15 minutes after the last full file for configurations that do not send the signal.
  • Safety: if more than half of the 1C products are missing, nothing is done and a warning is logged
    (looks like an interrupted exchange). A hidden product comes back as soon as it appears in an export again.
  • Translations (Polylang / WPML) follow the original product.

Security

  • The exchange password is stored only as a hash; after login a random session token is used.
  • 10 wrong passwords lock the IP for 15 minutes; an optional IP allowlist is available.
  • Temporary files live in a randomly named folder protected by .htaccess / web.config.
  • Strict file name checks (only xml / zip / images, no “..”, no symlinks); zip-slip and zip-bomb protection.
  • XML is parsed as a stream without network access or external entities (XXE-safe).
  • Statuses from 1C are applied only to orders the website itself sent to 1C.
  • Internal errors are written to the WooCommerce log only and are never shown to the client.

Trademarks

1C and 1C:Enterprise are trademarks of 1C Company. WooCommerce is a trademark of Automattic Inc.
GerSync is an independent plugin and is not affiliated with, endorsed or sponsored by 1C Company or Automattic.
sections.installation:
1. In WordPress go to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin, choose the zip file and click Install Now, then Activate.
    WooCommerce must be installed and active.
  2. Go to WooCommerce → Обмен с 1С (the GerSync settings page). Set an exchange login (Latin letters) and a long random password, then save.
  3. Copy the exchange URL shown at the top of the settings page, e.g. https://example.com/wc1c-exchange/.
  4. In 1C open Administration → Data exchange → Exchange with websites (the exact path depends on the configuration),
    create an exchange node and enter the URL, login and password from step 2–3.
  5. Choose what to exchange in 1C: products (catalog, prices, stock) and/or orders. Run the exchange.
  6. If products already exist on the website and have no 1C GUID, enable “Match existing products by SKU”
    before the first exchange to avoid duplicates.

It is strongly recommended to run the first exchange on a copy of the website or after making a database backup.

If 1C reports that the server did not receive the login/password

On some hosts (PHP running as CGI/FastCGI) the Authorization header does not reach PHP.
For Apache add this to .htaccess in the site root, before the WordPress rules:

RewriteEngine On
RewriteRule .* - [E=HTTP_AUTHORIZATION:%{HTTP:Authorization}]

For nginx + PHP-FPM add: fastcgi_param HTTP_AUTHORIZATION $http_authorization;

nginx note: .htaccess is ignored by nginx. Deny direct access to the wp-content/uploads/wc1c-exchange-* folder in the server config.
sections.faq:
Where can I see the 1C GUID of a product?

In the admin product editor, on the Inventory tab, and inside each variation. It is never shown on the storefront.

Where are the logs?

WooCommerce → Status → Logs, source gersync. Enable “detailed log” in the plugin settings for step-by-step entries.

What happens if I uninstall the plugin?

Settings and temporary files are removed. Products, categories and their 1C links stay, so reinstalling will not create duplicates.

Is it really free?

Yes. All features work without payment and nothing is locked. If the plugin saves you time, you can buy the author
a coffee via Buy Me a Coffee (link on the settings page). The link is shown only in the plugin’s own admin pages.

How do I update without losing settings?

Use the normal WordPress update (Plugins → Update). Settings, products and their 1C links are kept.
If you update manually with a zip file, choose “Upload Plugin” and then “Replace current with uploaded” —
do not delete the plugin first: deleting removes its settings (products and 1C links still stay).
sections.changelog:
1.4.0

  • Unique gersync prefix for code, options and metadata; automatic migration from 1.0–1.3.
  • Output escaped at the point of output; exchange request parameters read and sanitized individually.
  • Explicit nonce and capability check for the per-product “Do not update from 1C” checkbox.
  • Settings backup with automatic restore.

1.3.0

  • Ready for WordPress.org: name “GerSync Exchange for 1C”, slug and text domain gersync, admin assets enqueued, passes Plugin Check.
  • Data versioning with automatic migrations on update; uninstall keeps settings if another copy of the plugin is installed.
  • Fixed: exchange passwords containing quotes or backslashes were rejected on some servers.
  • Optional “buy the author a coffee” and author page links (admin only).
  • Unchanged products are skipped; no-op saves of prices and stock are avoided.
  • Images uploaded by the previous plugin are reused; optional WooCommerce-only thumbnail sizes.
  • Forced full exchange with a warning; background cleanup of unused exchange images.
  • Responses to 1C in Windows-1251 (no garbled messages in the 1C log).
  • New settings page: status summary and tabs (Connection, Catalog, Prices & stock, Orders, Advanced, Maintenance).

1.2.0

  • Full / changes-only export handling with an action for products missing from a full export.
  • Update protection for SKU, weight, prices and stock; per-product “Do not update from 1C” checkbox.
  • Attribute modes: sync / add only / don’t touch; manual visibility and order of attributes are preserved.
  • Translations are hidden and restored together with the original product.

1.1.0

  • Price types from the classifier in offers.xml (CommerceML 2.08+).
  • Products and variations are restored when the deletion mark is removed in 1C.
  • Fees are included in exported orders; statuses from 1C apply only to exported orders.
  • Polylang / WPML support; exchange URL no longer depends on rewrite rules.
  • 1C GUID shown for variations in the admin; import code split into modules.

1.0.0

  • First release.

short_description: GerSync: free two-way exchange between 1C:Enterprise and WooCommerce using the standard CommerceML 2 protocol: products, prices, stock and orders.
